purpose: SP6c/SP6d: NEURON reproduction of the published HL5MN1 (Yao 2022 HL23SST) fit at two recorded Allen long-square inputs of specimen 571700636, with a dt-halving pair for the decision limits. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-07-h01-donor-hl5mn1-import.md. Registered before any run; stage 1 opens only after .worktrees/h01-network/docs/evidence/h01-network-throughput.json exists (SP1 owns the machine) and the user approves.
compile_first: docker run --rm -v <worktree>/.cache/human-sst-l3/neuron-reference:/work -w /work braintrace-h01-neuron:9.0.2 nrnivmodl mod  (byte-identical to the HL5BN1 mod files; compiled once, x86_64/ stays in the cache)
input_datum: h01-sst-acquisition.json exports: sweep 44 (100 pA, bias 43.28 pA held, not injected: command-only input as in the PV finding) and sweep 35 (150 pA, bias 52.72 pA held). Human counts 14 and 34; sweep-44 repeats 44-47 give 14, 14, 13, 12.

1.title: Published fit, unmodified, fixed step 0.025 ms, and its dt-halving repeat
1.prediction: Counts equal the Allen sweeps exactly: 14 at 100 pA and 34 at 150 pA; first-spike latency within the dt-pair limit (|dt 0.025 - dt 0.0125| x 2.95) of 24.16 ms and 13.0 ms after step onset; every trace finite; axon-first initiation as in the HL5BN1 donor is not assumed and is only recorded.
1.rejection: A count differing from the Allen sweep by more than 1 at either input (12-14 is the human repeat band at 100 pA, so a model outside it also fails the repeat row), or a dt pair whose count differs (numerics not converged: report 'time level open', no verdict).
1.unchanged: NeuronTemplate.hoc, the eleven mod files, every value of biophys_HL5MN1.hoc, 34 C, initial -81.5 mV (the hoc e_pas), 270-1270 ms step, bias 0, 1500 ms, nseg factor 1 (the template's own segmentation), no CVode.
